task: HINT own-benchmark reproduction (foreclose the 'broken implementation' attack)
embeddings: dmis-lab/biobert-base-cased-v1.1 mean-pooled (768-d) substitute; authors' original biobert-embedding vectors not distributed (sentence2embedding.pkl ships as empty placeholder)
conclusion: Our HINT pipeline reproduces the published TOP phase III ROC-AUC (0.715 single / 0.730 bootstrap at 5 epochs vs published 0.721); 10 epochs does not improve it (0.710/0.711) so 5 epochs is converged, not under-trained. The 0.626 on our cohort therefore reflects the stricter compound-holdout split and cohort differences (notably ICD coverage 57% vs 100%), not a broken or under-trained implementation. The embedding substitution costs ~0.04 only under train/test mismatch (authors' weights + our embeddings = 0.678); it is internally consistent when trained and tested on the same embeddings.
run_env: local python3.12, torch 2.10 (CPU train, MPS embeddings), inside a fresh clone of futianfan/clinical-trial-outcome-prediction
